question: My lantern was delivered on November 20. What is the last day I can return it?
answer: The last day to start a return is January 31 of the following year. Orders delivered between November 1 and December 24 get the holiday extension [5]. A November 14, 2026 delivery, for example, has until January 31, 2027 [3].

Passages:

[1] about.md > What we believe
## What we believe

A lantern should last. Everything we sell is chosen or built to be repaired, and the Repair
Center will fix an out-of-warranty lantern at a fair price rather than tell you to buy a new one.
A policy should be plain. Our returns, shipping and warranty pages say what we do in numbers,
and the customer service team is allowed to say yes. A customer should be able to reach a person.
The phone is answered by someone in Frederick, Monday through Friday 8:30 AM to 6:00 PM and
Saturday 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern.

[2] returns-policy.md > What can be returned
## What can be returned

An item is eligible for return when all of the following are true:

- It is unused. A lantern that has been switched on to check that it works is still unused. A
  lantern that has been taken on a trip is not.
- It is in its original packaging with all accessories, inserts, manuals and the warranty card.
- It was purchased from Lantern Supply Co. directly: the online store, by phone, or at the
  Frederick or Annapolis showroom. Items bought from another retailer go back to that retailer.
- It is not on the final-sale list below.

[3] returns-policy.md > Worked examples
### Worked examples

Order LS-2026-004871 shipped on June 2, 2026 and was delivered on June 5, 2026. Day one is June 6.
The last day to start a return is July 15, 2026.

Order LS-2026-011302 was delivered on November 14, 2026. Under the ordinary rule the window
would close on December 24, 2026. Because the order was delivered between November 1 and
December 24, the holiday extension applies and the customer has until January 31, 2027.

Order LS-2026-009140 was picked up curbside at Frederick on September 9, 2026. The last day to
start a return is October 19, 2026.

[4] faq.md > My package says delivered but I don't have it. What now?
### My package says delivered but I don't have it. What now?

Check with neighbors and your building's office first; most packages turn up within a day. If it
has not arrived 10 business days after the expected delivery date, write to us with the order
number and we will ship a replacement before the carrier claim is settled.

[5] faq.md > I got it as a holiday gift. Is the return period longer?
### I got it as a holiday gift. Is the return period longer?

Yes. Any order delivered between November 1 and December 24 can be returned until January 31.
